plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Applied Apparel Studies Construction Certificate' program map, Catalog 2025-26, published July 26, 2025 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/6884/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 21 = 9+3+9, verified against the map's 9 / 3 / 9 headers. This is a Certificate of Achievement (no GE pattern; all courses are major core). The map's 'First Year'/'Second Year' headings are retained in the three numbered semesters as printed. In-plan prereqs sequenced: FASHN 351 requires FASHN 301 (C or better); FASHN 352 requires FASHN 301, 320, 351, and 364 (C or better) or equivalent; FASHN 355 requires FASHN 320, 351, and 364 (C or better) or equivalent; FASHN 368 requires FASHN 301 and 351 (C or better). Certificates of Achievement require a grade of C or better in each major course (map note). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
